Hi Garth —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses below and I attached our completed questionnaire for review.

Summary:
- BAA: We can provide a standard BAA and a redline within 3 business days; target turnaround to PrimeCare legal for signature: 7–10 business days after redline discussion.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 at rest. Customer KMS options: Redwood-managed keys, or customer-supplied keys (BYOK) via supported KMS providers. HSM-backed KMS available for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Deployment: Hosted (US regions), Dedicated GPU pools, and Private (VPC/on-prem) options — we can support US-only PHI processing.
- Retention & Audit: Per-route retention controls, token-level audit logs with CSV export; standard retention is configurable (30/90/365 days) and can be extended for compliance use-cases.

Attachments: Redwood_PrimeCare_HIPAA_Questionnaire_Filled.pdf (pdf)

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll loop in Rishi (legal) and Naomi (security/technical) for the BAA redline + evidence pack.
2) We’ll deliver a redline and technical evidence (SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram) by 20 Sep.
3) Suggest a technical review call the week of 21 Sep — let me know 30- or 60-minute windows.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Hi all —

Attached is the technical evidence pack for PrimeCare. Highlights:

- Dataflow: We isolate PHI at the request level. Short-lived KV caches and prefix caches are encrypted; multi-tenant separation is enforced at the model routing and container level. See phi_dataflow_diagram.png.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 for in-transit; AES-256-GCM at rest. All keys are stored in KMS; we support customer-supplied keys (BYOK) with KMS rotations. For Dedicated/Private customers we offer HSM-backed KMS options and physical isolation.
- Logging & Audit: Token-level audit trails, request/response hashes (redacted on request), and immutable append-only logs with export capability. SOC2 Type II attestation available (summary attached).
- Evidence links: SOC2 summary (SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf) and dataflow diagram (linked to our secure S3).

Attachments: phi_dataflow_diagram.png (png), SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (pdf)

If PrimeCare needs a live walkthrough, I can demo the VPC/Dedicated network topology and KMS integration with a short architecture session (30–45 min).

-naomi
